blocks.text: The module documentation defines full-jitter backoff, stable-connection reset, retry-after floors, failure categories, and fixed-text error handling.
blocks.title: Reconnect policy contract

blocks.text: LinkError subclasses represent authentication, protocol, store, internal, closure, connection, request, timeout, and message-size failures. Their attributes distinguish final errors from retryable transport conditions.
blocks.title: Link exception taxonomy

blocks.text: classify maps known fatal errors, retryable link errors, and common transport exceptions to fatal or retry. Anything else is unexpected and remains visible to the caller.
blocks.title: Failure classification

blocks.text: retry_after_of extracts the server's rate-limit hint. _finite rejects booleans, non-numbers, infinities, and NaN before policy construction.
blocks.title: Retry hints and numeric validation

blocks.text: BackoffPolicy stores base, factor, cap, stability, and retry-after limits and enforces positive or non-negative relationships.
blocks.title: Backoff policy validation

blocks.text: Backoff tracks consecutive failures, calculates a finite ceiling, draws a clamped random fraction, applies a bounded server floor, and resets after stable uptime.
blocks.title: Jittered delay sequence

gotchas: Unexpected exceptions are not swallowed or retried.
Only a connection meeting stable_after_s resets failures.
Error messages avoid server/library exception text.
how_it_works: Maps protocol and transport failures to stable categories
Carries validated retry metadata in typed errors
Draws capped jitter and resets after stable uptime
purpose: This module defines fixed-text link exceptions, separates fatal, retryable, and unexpected failures, and extracts server retry hints. Backoff uses exponential full jitter, resets after a stable connection, and never exceeds configured caps.
summary: Classifies device-link failures and calculates bounded full-jitter reconnect delays.
